title: On Transforming the whole valley in ten years
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：transform　|　正文 360 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 transform 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the fisherman ① transformed the whole valley in ten years with great care, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the fisherman ② transforms the whole valley in ten years on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ transform the whole valley in ten years at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ transformed the whole valley in ten years before — a line in the logbook for July 1960 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Transforming the whole valley in ten years with great care, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ transform the barn into three classrooms on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Transform the barn into three classrooms at once and never mention it again.

By 1973 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a new boatman from the next harbour ⑧ transforms the barn into three classrooms with great care every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pier, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ transformed the whole valley in ten years again when nobody else would.

⑩ To transform the whole valley in ten years, my mother said in 1978, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, somebody transforms the whole valley in ten years on the same day again and somebody must transform the whole valley in ten years with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 改变（一般过去式 transformed the whole valley in ten years：1966 年渔人头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 改变（一般现在 transforms the whole valley in ten years：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 改变（不定式 to transform the whole valley in ten years：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 改变（过去完成时 had transformed the whole valley in ten years：1960 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 改变（动名词 transforming the whole valley in ten years 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 改造（transform the barn into three classrooms：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去改造把谷仓改成了三间教室）
G. v. 改造（transform the barn into three classrooms：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 改变（后段两处：新来的船工照例 transforms the barn into three classrooms，而母亲又一次 transformed the whole valley in ten years）

transform 意为“改变”，航海日志里 七月 那行字说明早在 1973 年之前就有人改变过，故用过去完成时 had transformed。

transform 意为“改变”，结尾那句是母亲 1978 年的话：要改变十年里改变了整条山谷，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和渔港记住的那一件。

answers: In 1966 the fisherman transformed the whole valley in ten years with great care, and nobody in the harbour forgot it.
